title: Maida Ka Lafda!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

MAIDA.look: A white, puffy cloud-like figure with a sly smile and a tiny chef's hat, floating playfully.

ATTA.look: A sturdy, earthy brown character, shaped like a sack of whole wheat, with a reassuring, wise smile.

BAJRA.look: A cheerful, small character made of vibrant, tiny millet grains, wearing a tiny leaf garland, bouncing slightly.

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] floating confidently, a mischievous grin, winking.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Arre bhai, main hoon Maida! Tumhara favourite item!
scenes.say: अरे भाई, मैं हूँ मैदा! तुम्हारा फेवरेट आइटम!

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] floating confidently, a mischievous grin, winking.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Samose, bhature, cake... sabmein mera hi jalwa hai, bhidu!
scenes.say: समोसे, भटूरे, केक... सबमें मेरा ही जलवा है, भिडू!

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] floating confidently, a mischievous grin, winking.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Par ek baat bataun, main thoda fraud hoon!
scenes.say: पर एक बात बताऊँ, मैं थोड़ा फ़्रॉड हूँ!

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] looking a bit sheepish, shrugging, hands up in a "what can I do?" gesture.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Mere andar fiber naam ki cheez nahin ke barabar hai.
scenes.say: मेरे अंदर फ़ाइबर नाम की चीज़ नहीं के बराबर है.

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] looking a bit sheepish, shrugging, hands up in a "what can I do?" gesture.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Isiliye toh, kha ke bhi pet khali-khali sa lagta hai.
scenes.say: इसीलिये तो, खा के भी पेट खाली-खाली सा लगता है.

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] looking a bit sheepish, shrugging, hands up in a "what can I do?" gesture.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Phir bhookh lagti hai, aur zyada khane ka man karta hai.
scenes.say: फिर भूख लगती है, और ज़्यादा खाने का मन करता है.

scenes.image: [[ATTA]] standing firmly, a reassuring smile, gesturing proudly to himself.
scenes.speaker: ATTA
scenes.line: Tension nahin lene ka, main hoon aapka dost, gehu ka atta.
scenes.say: टेंशन नहीं लेने का, मैं हूँ आपका दोस्त, गेंहू का आटा.

scenes.image: [[ATTA]] standing firmly, a reassuring smile, gesturing proudly to himself.
scenes.speaker: ATTA
scenes.line: Mere paas bhar-bhar ke fiber hai, bhidu!
scenes.say: मेरे पास भर-भर के फ़ाइबर है, भिडू!

scenes.image: [[ATTA]] standing firmly, a reassuring smile, gesturing proudly to himself.
scenes.speaker: ATTA
scenes.line: Mere se pet bharega, der tak bhara rahega, sahi pakde hain!
scenes.say: मेरे से पेट भरेगा, देर तक भरा रहेगा, सही पकड़े हैं!

scenes.image: [[BAJRA]] energetically bouncing, small grains glowing, a wide, friendly smile.
scenes.speaker: BAJRA
scenes.line: Arre bhai, main bhi hoon Bajra! Aur mere bhai bhi hain!
scenes.say: अरे भाई, मैं भी हूँ बाजरा! और मेरे भाई भी हैं!

scenes.image: [[BAJRA]] energetically bouncing, small grains glowing, a wide, friendly smile.
scenes.speaker: BAJRA
scenes.line: Hum sab millets, pet ko tagda fiber dete hain.
scenes.say: हम सब मिलेट्स, पेट को तगड़ा फ़ाइबर देते हैं.

scenes.image: [[BAJRA]] energetically bouncing, small grains glowing, a wide, friendly smile.
scenes.speaker: BAJRA
scenes.line: Hum khate hi pet ekdum bhar jata hai aur healthy bhi!
scenes.say: हम खाते ही पेट एकdum भर जाता है और हेल्दी भी!

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] looking thoughtful, a bit regretful, making a "cut it down" gesture with his hands.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Baat toh sahi hai, yeh dono ekdum solid hain.
scenes.say: बात तो सही है, ये दोनों एकdum सॉलिड हैं.

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] looking thoughtful, a bit regretful, making a "cut it down" gesture with his hands.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Zyada Maida khane se pet mein gadbad ho sakti hai.
scenes.say: ज़्यादा मैदा खाने से पेट में गडबड़ हो सकती है.

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] looking thoughtful, a bit regretful, making a "cut it down" gesture with his hands.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Agar health problem hai, toh doctor se baat zaroor karna.
scenes.say: अगर हेल्थ प्रॉब्लम है, तो डॉक्टर से बात ज़रूर करना.

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] winking, holding up one finger for "a little bit", then posing a curious question.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Main taste mein achha hoon, par kam khaoge toh theek rahega.
scenes.say: मैं टेस्ट में अच्छा हूँ, पर कम खाओगे तो ठीक रहेगा.

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] winking, holding up one finger for "a little bit", then posing a curious question.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Roz-roz meri cheezen mat thuso, healthy option bhi hain.
scenes.say: रोज़-रोज़ मेरी चीज़ें मत ठूसो, हेल्दी ऑप्शन भी हैं.

scenes.image: [[MAIDA]] winking, holding up one finger for "a little bit", then posing a curious question.
scenes.speaker: MAIDA
scenes.line: Aap Maida se bani kaunsi cheez sabse zyada khate ho?
scenes.say: आप मैदा से बनी कौनसी चीज़ सबसे ज़्यादा खाते हो?
